selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods with an explicit 2010 constitutional transition; local ratings do not inherit Netherlands- or Kingdom-wide sports evidence.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
Netherlands- and Kingdom-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No tennis federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
The 2010 constitutional transition is identity context only, not sports-performance evidence.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
